projects.title: Chilean Teaching Portfolio - AI-Powered Educational Platform
bodyText: Web application designed for teachers to support the creation and management of their Teaching Portfolio.
AI-assisted generation of lesson plans, assessments, and educational resources.
Tools designed to support teaching work and structure content according to Chilean educational requirements.
Frontend developed with React and Vite.
Backend developed with Node.js and Express, with data persistence in PostgreSQL.

projects.title: Project Tracker - Project Management System
bodyText: Web application for project management and tracking.
Centralizes project information and facilitates monitoring of project status and progress.
Interface focused on managing and visualizing operational information.
System deployed as a web application accessible through cloud infrastructure.

projects.title: SIMCE Practice Tests - Results Management System
bodyText: Web application for managing, processing, and analyzing SIMCE practice test results.
Visualization of results by student, class, question, and indicator to facilitate academic performance tracking.
Generation of metrics, achievement percentages, and reports to support the analysis of practice test results.
Use of artificial intelligence as a support tool for reviewing and grading tests.
Frontend developed with React and Vite.
Backend developed with Node.js and Express, using Prisma ORM and PostgreSQL for data management.
Application deployed with Docker on cloud infrastructure.

projects.title: Diversified Educational Assistant - AI-Powered Lesson Planning
bodyText: Web application for creating educational lesson plans with the support of specialized artificial intelligence.
Assisted generation of activities, teaching strategies, assessments, and classroom resources.
Integration of generative artificial intelligence through Gemini APIs.
Frontend developed with React and Vite.
Backend developed with Node.js and Express, using Prisma ORM and PostgreSQL for data management.
Application deployed with Docker on cloud infrastructure.

projects.title: Biotik - Full-Stack Web Application
bodyText: Corporate website and main platform for Biotik.
Frontend developed with React and Vite.
Backend developed with Node.js and Express.
Data persistence and management using PostgreSQL.
Application deployed on cloud infrastructure using Google Cloud Platform, Docker, and Nginx Proxy Manager.

projects.title: Biotik - ODK Management Platform
bodyText: Web platform for managing users, projects, and ODK-related processes.
Real-time monitoring of project status and progress using WebSockets.
Visualization of reports, operational data, and interactive maps.
Integration with Google Drive and Google Maps for information management and visualization.
Application deployed on cloud infrastructure using Docker and Google Cloud Platform.

projects.title: Biotik - ODK Data Processing
bodyText: System for managing and processing data obtained from ODK Central servers.
Automation of project processing and information consolidation using Python and Flask.
Automatic generation of reports and results in Google Sheets.
Data processing and storage using PostgreSQL.
Application deployed on cloud infrastructure using Docker and Google Cloud Platform.

projects.title: ComicsKites - Full-Stack Web Application
bodyText: Web application for an online store specializing in comics.
Frontend developed with React and Vite.
Backend developed with Node.js and Express.
Data persistence and management using PostgreSQL.
Final project developed during the Full-Stack program at Desafío Latam.

App deployed on GitHub Pages.

App deployed on Netlify and Render.com.

projects.title: Caregivers - Web App

Data obtained from JSON.
App deployed on GitHub Pages.

bodyText: Web application that retrieves Pokémon data from an API.
Frontend developed with React.
Data obtained from the PokeAPI.
App deployed on GitHub Pages.
